Package com.egradx.auth.security

Interface EgradxTenantContextAccessor

All Known Implementing Classes:
EgradxThreadLocalTenantContextAccessor
public interface EgradxTenantContextAccessor
Access to the current request's EgradxTenantContext. An interface, not a static holder — egradx-auth is a library many different host apps' service classes inject this into, and a static class would foreclose substituting a fake in tests or ever swapping the storage mechanism (e.g. a future reactive variant using Reactor Context instead of a ThreadLocal) without a breaking API change for every consumer. set/clear are called only by EgradxAuthenticationFilter — host-app code should only ever call current().
